description:
About the company
 Our client is a software company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Own the delivery of customer-facing web application functionality, working across user interface and server-side code. Partner with other engineers and customer-facing colleagues to turn requirements into reliable, easy-to-use releases. This is an individual contributor position on a small engineering team.
 What you'll do
 - Deliver new application capabilities spanning both the user interface and the server side.
 - Guide larger initiatives from technical design to release, working alongside engineering peers and customer-facing colleagues.
 - Shape clear, approachable interfaces for information-heavy business workflows.
 - Develop features powered by AI that take over tasks people used to do by hand.
 - Strengthen the speed, stability and structure of the application as usage grows, using direct customer input.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - At least 3 years of professional experience shipping web applications that run in production.
 - Hands-on skill with responsive, interactive user interfaces as well as the server-side services that power them.
 - Working knowledge of how to structure client-side code and state, design APIs, and model data in a relational database.
 - Sound product sense and an eye for usability, especially in screens that present a lot of information.
 - A history of owning a problem from early idea through design, build and live operation, with high standards for quality and user experience.
 Bonus points
 - Prior work on features that use AI.
 - Experience speaking directly with users to inform what gets built.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 180,000 to 250,000 per year
 - Equity
 - Health, dental and vision coverage
 - Paid time off and paid holidays
 Location and work model
 - New York City, NY, United States
 - On-site, 5 days per week
 - Full-time
